artifacts.notes: Complete offered 544-page documentary collection, not complete originals of every act. Historical documents and editorial framing remain distinguished.
artifacts.rights_basis: Identified historical printing published before 1931 is public domain in the United States under the repository rights policy. Faithful mechanical reproduction and automated OCR add no original human-authored matter. Historical source content is excluded from Triptych’s CC BY 4.0 licence.

edition.publication: Veglae, 1906; sumptibus ephemeridis Slavorum litterae theologicae, Pragae
edition.title: Fontes historici liturgiae Glagolito-Romanae a XIII ad XIX saeculum

work.author: Lucas Jelić
work.description: Historical documentary collection on the Glagolitic Roman liturgy, compiled and indexed by Lucas Jelić. A scholarly edition of documents, not the original instrument or a celebrant missal; abridgments and date errors require comparison with original witnesses.
work.title: Fontes historici liturgiae Glagolito-Romanae a XIII ad XIX saeculum
